messages.subject: Missing value in response
parts:
Hi, everyone. I have one question about missing value. I try to give the initials of the missing part in the response only. And I just want to set the missing part of response in the monitors. Is there any way to make it? Thanks!


data <- list(y=y_locf,Q=Q)
inits <- list(item_den = diag(2),
              y=y_locf)
monitors=c("gamma","lambda","beta","delta","y")

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: Missing value in response
parts:
Yes, in the initial values list, provide a data structure with numeric values where missing values occur, and NA's where observations occur.  And in the data list, provide a data structure (of exactly the same length or dimension) with NA's where the missing values occur, and numeric values where the observations occur.

Also, there is no way to only monitor part of a variable - in your case, the unobserved part of the response.  If you really wanted to, you could define a different deterministic variable, where the elements of this new variable are defined as the unobserved elements of the response variable.  Then, set a monitor for this new variable.

Hope this helps,
Daniel
